one row per marker: Haemoglobin is an iron-rich protein in your red blood cells. It carries oxygen from your lungs to the rest of your body. The test measures the level of haemoglobin in your blood.
shown under the: MedlinePlus (U.S. National Library of Medicine), "Hemoglobin Test"

one row per marker: HbA1c shows your average level of blood glucose (blood sugar) over the past two to three months. Glucose sticks to haemoglobin for as long as the red blood cells are alive, and red blood cells live about three months.
shown under the: MedlinePlus (U.S. National Library of Medicine), "Hemoglobin A1C (HbA1c) Test"

one row per marker: Ferritin is a protein that binds to iron and stores it in your body. The test measures the level of ferritin in your blood, which shows how much iron you have stored.
shown under the: MedlinePlus (U.S. National Library of Medicine), "Ferritin Blood Test"

# IN2FIT marker explanations: what a lab: Vitamin D|25-oh vitamin d|vitamin d 25 hydroxy|25 hydroxy vitamin d|vitamin d3|vitamin d total
one row per marker: The test measures the level of vitamin D in your blood. Vitamin D helps your body absorb calcium to build healthy bones and teeth, and helps keep your muscles, nerves and immune system working normally.
shown under the: MedlinePlus (U.S. National Library of Medicine), "Vitamin D Test"

one row per marker: The test measures the amount of vitamin B12 in your blood. B12 (cobalamin) gives your body energy and helps keep your nerves and blood cells healthy.
shown under the: MedlinePlus (U.S. National Library of Medicine), "Vitamin B Test"

one row per marker: The pituitary gland makes thyroid-stimulating hormone (TSH), which tells your thyroid how much thyroid hormone it needs to make. The test measures this hormone in your blood.
shown under the: MedlinePlus (U.S. National Library of Medicine), "TSH (Thyroid-stimulating hormone) Test"

# IN2FIT marker explanations: what a lab: Glucose|blood glucose|fasting glucose|fasting blood sugar|fbs|random blood sugar|plasma glucose|glucose fasting|blood sugar
one row per marker: A blood glucose test measures the glucose level in your blood. Glucose is a type of sugar; it is your body's main source of energy.
shown under the: MedlinePlus (U.S. National Library of Medicine), "Blood Glucose Test"
